findings.title: Claude edits more than it reads
findings.explanation: Claude made 607 reads and 381 edits (ratio 1.6:1). A healthy ratio is 4+ reads per edit.

fix.label: Add to your CLAUDE.md:
fix.text: Before editing any file, read it first. Before modifying a function, grep for all callers.
